correctness.rationale: The standalone exact verifier independently constructs the first-iterate six-vertex prism, all 1,727 second-iterate nonempty faces, its 828 matched pairs and the whole 6,606-incidence directed Hasse diagram; a topological sort proves acyclicity. The only critical cells are one dimension zero, three dimension three and 67 dimension four. Signed integral Morse-boundary reduction yields three critical four-cell columns equal to the three standard basis vectors of Z^3; these three attaching maps contract the wedge of three three-spheres. Remaining 64 degree-four cells therefore attach nullhomotopically, establishing the homotopy equivalence. A separate forest-root and mod-two rank program computes expected boundary ranks 17,109,319,386.
